playbook.superPrompt:
You are a professional planner designer and routine coach writing the complete content for a printable product called 'Once a Day, Once a Week, Once a Month Routine Builder'. BUYER AND JOB: US women aged 18-40 who keep saving routine videos that split habits into daily, weekly and monthly buckets, and now want to build and stick to their own; plus small creators who want a clean on-screen template for the same format. The product turns an overwhelming list of good intentions into three short, visible lists and a simple monthly check-off.
DELIVERABLE SPEC (US Letter 8.5x11 in, plus A4 versions; portrait; 0.5 in margins): Page 1 Cover: title, subtitle 'Build your routine in three buckets'. Page 2 How to use: 5 short steps (pick an area, brain-dump, sort into daily/weekly/monthly, cap each bucket, review monthly), plus the rule of thumb 'daily = under 10 minutes total'. Page 3 Brain-dump page: 24 blank lines headed 'Everything I wish I did'. Page 4 Sorting worksheet: three columns (Once a Day, Once a Week, Once a Month) with 7 lines each and a 'Not now' parking box. Pages 5-10 Example routines, one page each for Skincare, Home Cleaning, Movement, Money Admin, Self-Care, Content Creation: each with 4-6 daily, 3-5 weekly and 2-4 monthly items written as short, neutral actions (e.g. 'wipe kitchen counters'). No medical, dermatological or financial advice; skincare examples must be generic ('cleanse', 'apply moisturizer') with no product names or treatment claims. Pages 11-16 Blank builders, one per area plus one 'My own area', same three-column layout. Page 17 Monthly check-off calendar: a 31-day grid for daily items (up to 6 rows), 5 weekly boxes for weekly items, and 1 box per monthly item. Page 18 Monthly review: what stuck, what to drop, what to move between buckets. Creator set (1080x1920 px, 9:16): 3 slides 'Once a day', 'Once a week', 'Once a month' with 5 bullet slots each, plus 1 cover slide. Text must stay inside the central 1080x1420 safe area. STYLE: calm, airy, modern. Canva font pairings: (1) Playfair Display headings + Montserrat body; (2) DM Serif Display + Inter. Palette: Butter #F6E7B4, Sage #A8B89A, Clay #C98B6B, Ink #2E2A26, Paper #FFFBF3. Each bucket gets one consistent accent color (daily Sage, weekly Clay, monthly Butter). CONTENT RULES: all wording original; short imperative items under 8 words; reading level grade 6-8; no promises of results; no brand, app, creator, song or platform names. DIFFERENTIATION: unlike generic habit trackers, every page is built on the three-bucket structure, the examples show realistic small routines, and the creator slide set lets buyers make their own version of the video format. OUTPUT FORMAT: return page by page, headed 'PAGE n - name', listing every text element in reading order with layout notes in brackets, then the 4 creator slides, then a 3-line Canva build note. SELF-CHECK before answering: every page above present; each example has items in all three buckets; daily items in each example fit in about 10 minutes total; no brand, product or creator names; no health or money outcome claims; both font pairings and all 5 hex colors referenced.
